verifier.notes: Blind pass agreed — this was the clearest ABSENT in the batch. My own searches: rg -n 'Elements|elements of' --glob '*.v' finds no category-of-elements construction (all hits are prose or unrelated section headings such as Instance/Sets/Coend.v:68 and Instance/FinSet/Pushout.v:309,430); rg -in 'category of elements' -> the single prose hit at Construction/Grothendieck.v:108, re-read and confirmed verbatim ('Restricting the fibres to sets, viewed as discrete categories, recovers the category of elements el(F), whose projection is a discrete opfibration'). The record's diagnosis of why Construction/Grothendieck.v cannot be reused is correct: Grothendieck takes an IndexedCat (Cat-valued with a coherence pack) and Construction/Grothendieck/Strict.v's IndexedCat_of_StrictFunctor needs a strict B ⟶ Cat under fibrewise UIP, neither of which a Sets-valued presheaf is packaged as. Additionally, the p_! leg of the lemma is unreachable independently: LeftKan has no instance in-tree (see the change-of-base record). ABSENT stands.
